If p1 lands on the pinks and must sell, he could raise about $400 by selling his eight orange houses for half price.

I considered building one house on each green property for $600, but mortgaging Kentucky Avenue would leave me with only about $231 in liquid cash. That is far too thin against the $1100 blue rent threat, so I will not build. I will end my turn.
